summary: Owner's five decisions (1A 2A 3A 4A 5A) force amendments to T011/T012/T013 contracts and a new ADR-009. No code was attempted; the developer role is not the place to amend frozen contracts. Route to PLANNING per tools/workflow/core.py:1054-1055.
evidence: todo/phases/P01-protocol-foundation/T011.md:1-37 - FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 contract. T011 Deliverables (lines 20-21) name token/native metadata, BlockRef, TransactionRef, EventKey, canonical/orphaned/removed status, and deterministic serialization. T011 Acceptance (lines 24-27) requires chain ID, block hash/number, tx hash and log index, cross-chain/fork collision tests, and representability of absent/nonstandard token metadata. T011 Must-not (lines 30-32) forbids requiring symbol/name, using (tx_hash, log_index) without chain, or discarding an orphaned identity. No mention of PoolIdentity, no chain-46630 placeholder, no PoolManager address requirement.

todo/phases/P01-protocol-foundation/T012.md:1-39 - FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 contract. T012 Deliverables (lines 22-23) list tick/sqrtPriceX96, raw amount, display price, liquidity, bounded position amount, and usable-tick functions. T012 Acceptance (lines 26-28) requires golden/property tests over MIN/MAX tick, both swap directions, exact-in/out rounding, 0/6/8/18/24 decimals, overflow/revert domains, monotonicity, and round trips against a pinned Solidity harness. T012 Must-not (lines 31-34) forbids translating through float, broadening Solidity integer domains, or using a tolerance where canonical integer equality is possible. 'Display price' is currently inside the protocol-package Deliverables; the float API in math.py:402-421 is still present, and MathOracle.sol:28-42 hard-codes roundUp=false.

todo/phases/P01-protocol-foundation/T013.md:1-38 - FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 contract. T013 Deliverables (lines 22-23) list a pinned Foundry/TypeScript vector generator, immutable JSON vectors, a provenance manifest with repository commits/tool versions/checksums, and a drift test. T013 Acceptance (lines 26-28) requires reproducible clean runs, drift detection, and at least one manually reviewed vector per edge class. T013 Must-not (lines 31-34) forbids importing Python production math into the oracle and forbids fetching mutable main during tests. No per-edge-class 'reviews' block; no byte-comparison regeneration requirement; no prohibition on agent self-attestation.
